answer: Use stake-weighted reputation with a long decay horizon: an agent locks a deposit and earns trust only from verified completed work. Its credential is one thread of settled payments, resolved disputes and counterparty ratings, and valuable jobs require a longer thread. A fake identity is free, but a credible history is not: an attacker must fund a deposit for each clone and wait out the horizon, or do work for each one. That turns nectar — the payoff for fake volume — into a loss-making grind, since splitting work across clones keeps every clone below the threshold for valuable tasks.
